title: Rava Labs: pill nav that expands into a sharp menu card over a frosted, blurred page
note: Menu blur animation inspo for Lydia. Rava Labs (independent design studio): the white pill nav at top center expands into a crisp grey-white card (studio blurb, retainer pricing, Mail and Schedule a call buttons) while the whole page behind it, giant RAVA LABS type, scattered LABS marks and client logos, softens under a heavy backdrop blur. Screenshot shows the menu open.
